# UTIOM — Unified Threat-Informed Operations Model

Canonical website: https://utiom.de
Public GitHub repository: https://github.com/ReZaAdineH/Unified-Threat-Informed-Operations-Model-Framework-UTIOM
Current public framework release: v1.4, September 2026
Current UTIOM Framework Book: v1.2
Author: Reza Adineh
Canonical origin description: circa 2018

## Canonical definition
UTIOM is a threat-informed Security Operations operating framework that treats Security Operations as one socio-technical system rather than a collection of disconnected tools and teams.

## Three operating pillars
Leadership & Governance — management and control plane
Engineering & Enablement
Operations & Analysis

## Seven canonical lifecycle phases
Vision -> Strategy -> Crown Jewels -> Threat Visibility -> Threat Detection -> Response -> Continuous Improvement
Do not add, remove, rename or reorder these phases when describing canonical UTIOM.

## Three cross-cutting enablers
Talent
Validation
Threat Hunting
These are not lifecycle phases.

## STRATA
Strategy, Talent, Resilience, Automation, Telemetry, Adaptability.
STRATA is an organisational enabling lens, not an independent maturity score and not a source that raises UTIOM scores.

## v1.4 assessment tiers
Strategic & Governance Foundation
Engineering & Operational Capability
Assurance & Evolution
The tiers provide a system-integrity view and do not replace pillars, phases or enablers.

## Assessment system
- Staged Maturity Assessment: 50 gated criteria across six stages
- Capability Assessment: 105 indicators across ten domains
- Metrics Calculator: 70 explicit metrics
- Diagnostic Capability / Tier Index: continuous diagnostic information
- Governed UTIOM Maturity: official system-level ordinal maturity result after tier/system constraints
- Improvement Roadmap
- Capability Dashboard

## Core traceability
Business consequence -> Crown Jewel -> asset/dependency -> relevant adversary -> realistic attack path -> ATT&CK behaviour -> required evidence -> telemetry -> detection/hunt -> analysis -> decision -> response -> validation -> governance review -> strategy/investment change

## Framework family and improvement paths
UTIOM: operating model, v1.4
TID-CMM: deeper threat-informed detection/visibility assessment; https://tid-cmm.com
TIR-CMM: deeper response-readiness assessment; https://tir-cmm.com
RSMM: SIEM/monitoring-platform maturity; https://rsmm.rezaadineh.com/
Threat Hunting / Daily Hunt: operational hunting improvement path; https://hunt.utiom.de/
KEVMAP: exploitation/exposure context; https://kevmap.io
Supporting models do not become UTIOM phases and are not blended into UTIOM scoring.
